0.original: A problem weighs heavy on Eshana's mind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Obtain fish mint at East End.

25.original: Deliver the fish mint to Jagranti.

26.original: Deliver the jar of fish mint salve to Eshana.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I have need of your assistance in preparing supplies quite vital to me and my sssisters.

49.original: As you know, we Ananta take great pride in the appearance of our skin, and the lussstrous sheen of our scales. We require a special salve for our tails, which are prone to scarring from our ceaselesss patrols of the area.

50.original: Before I can distribute any to my sssisters, however, we must ready ingredients to make more. It requires a great deal of time to produce, you see, and I would not have our ssstores empty the next time we are in need of treatment.

51.original: I would ask you to travel to East End and procure four leaves of fish mint, a medicinal plant which grows at the base of the trees there. When you've found them, pray deliver them to Jagranti. She is the head of our medical station.

53.original: Would that I could go and retrieve more herbs for our medicine, but I cannot leave this place unattended.

54.original: Eshana requires salve for our sssisters? Then she knows we must first have more herbs.

55.original: Ah, this is more than enough. Thank you. I'll set to making more sssalve right away.

56.original: For now give her this. It is the last of our reserves until I can make more. This will take time of course, but it should be ready before we have need of it.

57.original: You are returned. Was Jagranti able to provide you with any sssalve?

58.original: Wonderful. My sssisters will be relieved to have this.

59.original: Care for our tails is more than a matter of beauty, after all.

60.original: A tail marred with scars for usss is like a pair of boots riddled with holes for you ssstriders. We can have no hindrances if we are to respond quickly to an emergency.

61.original: Take that salve to Eshana. Our ssstores should be replenished before we have need of it again.
